implementation_scope: source-backed V3 peer-clear, dynamic outward and explicit RETURN through frozen V9 scheduler; synthetic replay only
not_equivalent_to_training_relay: Conservative adapter waits for stable prepare/return completion; training allows locomotion preemption and interval-based handoff.
Training FK hand/racket/TTC guards and real source coordinates/limits remain unverified; 85D ABI is not a substitute.
Projection uses frozen planner pure methods and controller@47359de motion pelvis/deadband conventions; exact dirty controller reference patch remains missing.
protocol_memory: Capture first confirmed prepare target pair for the shot, matching V3 first protocol-applied capture; later peer-clear/RETURN targets are separately logged and do not overwrite actor memory.

statuses.accepted: Frozen scheduler clone accepted and latched the request; not physical completion.
statuses.rejected: Validation or scheduler rejected; offline batch has no applied side effects.
statuses.completed: Matched target within 0.06m, fixture planar speed <=0.15m/s, hold phase for >=0.10s. Not real-world completion.

atomicity: Offline batch preview only. Distributed acceptance/partial execution must be handled by a future dedicated bridge; no distributed atomicity claimed.
failure: Latch FAULT and issue no new commands. Existing scheduler motion is not stopped. Recovery requires a new explicit synthetic session; real reconciliation is not implemented.
return: Explicit RETURN to projected next_hitter_return_y after both outward/peer-clear goals complete; repeat pending request until matched acceptance, then wait for stable completion.
hold: No HOLD command is exposed. Existing fixed_relay hold is no-op, never a stop mechanism.
online_gate: No ROS/LCM/device transport or active switch exists. Complete V3 relay semantic equivalence is an online blocker even after real input evidence is supplied.
